title: Context Memory Node Schema
description: Schema for storing, retrieving, and managing workflow context variables used as AI memory or temporary storage.

operation.description: Operation to perform (STORE, RETRIEVE, APPEND, CLEAR, LIST)

key.description: Context key used for the variable

overwrite.description: When false, STORE keeps the original value if the key already exists

default_value.description: Value returned by RETRIEVE when the key does not exist

persistent.description: If true, uses persistent WriteOptions when writing values

result.description: Operation summary. Example: STORE => {stored:true,key:'chat_history'}, RETRIEVE => {found:true,value:[...]}, APPEND => {appended:true,size:3}
